errors.text: The required 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell boundary is replaced by a vague >200-atom criterion and benchmark cells of only 64-256 atoms, which cannot validate the target finite-size condition.

The response incorrectly elevates SRO-induced VDOS changes and kink-pair/DAPB physics to the structural mediator for FEP. The target mediator is low-error reproduction of the DFT phase-space distribution and correspondingly small MTP-DFT energy-difference variance.

It suggests that the MTP itself must capture electronic DOS-gap shifts. Electronic excitation free energies are separate DFT-level corrections rather than structural information that an ordinary interatomic MTP is expected to reproduce.

The cited evidence concerns other alloys, low-temperature phonons, magnetism, and dislocation strengthening; it does not validate MTP-FEP accuracy, the TaVCrW SRO free energy, or the claimed computational speedup.
